SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.account_group_id=#{groupId} AND AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_creator_deletion d WHERE d.account_id=a.id OR d.creator_phone=a.creator_deletion_identity_phone)
SELECT * FROM account_creator_deletion WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND group_execution_id=#{executionId}

SELECT d.tenant_id, d.lifecycle, d.task_id, d.group_execution_id FROM account a INNER JOIN account_creator_deletion d ON d.account_id=a.id OR d.creator_phone=a.creator_deletion_identity_phone WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_group_account r INNER JOIN pull_task_group_execution e ON e.id=r.group_execution_id AND e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.account_id IN () AND e.execution_status IN (0,1,2,3) AND r.released_at IS NULL AND NOT (r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.group_execution_id=#{groupExecutionId} AND r.task_id=#{taskId} AND r.account_id=#{accountId} AND r.role_type=4) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketing_account_occupancy o INNER JOIN marketing_task mt ON mt.id=o.marketing_task_id AND mt.tenant_id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_task gp ON gp.marketing_task_id=mt.id AND gp.tenant_id=mt.tenant_id WHERE o.account_id IN () AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((mt.business_type=1 AND mt.status IN (1,2,5)) OR (mt.business_type=2 AND gp.resource_status IN (2,3))) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM join_task_result r INNER JOIN join_task t ON t.id=r.join_task_id AND t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.account_id IN () AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status NOT IN ('STOPPED','DONE','FAILED') FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_account_usage u INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_runtime t ON t.hyperlink_task_id=u.hyperlink_task_id AND t.tenant_id=u.tenant_id WHERE u.account_id IN () AND (t.run_status IN (0,1,3) OR u.in_flight_count>0) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feed_task_account a INNER JOIN feed_task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_id IN () AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.task_status IN (0,1,3) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contact_friend_task_account a INNER JOIN contact_friend_task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_id IN () AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.run_status IN (0,1,3) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM group_pull_marketing_execution e WHERE (e.builder_account_id IN () OR e.marketing_account_id IN ()) AND e.execution_status IN (1,2,7) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historical_group_pull_execution e WHERE (e.operation_account_id IN () OR e.puller_account_id IN ()) AND (e.pull_status IN (0,1) OR e.marketing_status IN (1,2)) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM script_marketing_send_record r WHERE r.account_id IN () AND r.status IN (1,4,5) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_mutual_contact_item i WHERE (i.actor_id IN () OR i.target_id IN ()) AND i.status IN (1,2,5) FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM normal_group_creation_item i WHERE i.creator_account_id IN () AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RESULT_UNKNOWN') AND i.current_step<>'DONE' FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM normal_group_creation_item_member m INNER JOIN normal_group_creation_item i ON i.id=m.item_id AND i.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.member_account_id IN () AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RESULT_UNKNOWN') AND i.current_step<>'DONE' FOR UPDATE) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM protocol_command_outbox o WHERE o.protocol_account_id IN (SELECT protocol_account_id FROM account WHERE creator_deletion_identity_phone=#{creatorPhone}) AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status IN (0,1,5,6) FOR UPDATE) )

SELECT a.id AS account_id, t.steps_json, g.bindings_json FROM account a INNER JOIN script_marketing_task t ON t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND t.status IN (1,2) LEFT JOIN script_marketing_group g ON g.task_id=t.id AND g.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE a.creator_deletion_identity_phone=#{phone} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account_creator_deletion SET lifecycle='DELETING',operation_id=#{binding.operationId},updated_at=#{now} WHERE AND lifecycle='RESERVED' AND operation_id IS NULL
UPDATE account_creator_deletion SET lifecycle='DELETED',updated_at=#{now},completed_at=#{now} WHERE AND lifecycle='DELETING' AND operation_id=#{binding.operationId}
UPDATE account_state SET desired_login_state=2,state_source='CREATOR_DELETION',updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
